title: STASH TYPE FLOOR 16PX AND $ GOING UP
why: The stash labels, tabs, counts, key bar and hint lines painted at 13px, under the 16px floor of the style guide, and the loadout head showed the old credits letter c. Type is 17.4px (16px after the 0.92 scale) and the head reads $ going up (his Q59).
now: The stash text is 16px or more and the loadout head says $ going up.
